title.zh: 复盘：首个动作之后，留一个别人的选择
title.en: Review the choice after the first action

paragraphs.zh: 沿用种灯节首颗纸种，只画两格：第一格是已约好的小动作，第二格留给另一角色选择回应、换方向或结束。请愿意的读者指出哪里能接续，也可只写文字。复盘看开头是否留了空间，不用谁先动手、剧情是否继续评领导、勇气或责任，更不要求一个人完成全场。
paragraphs.en: For the festival’s first paper seed, make two panels: an agreed small action, then room for another character to respond, change direction or end the scene. Ask a willing reader where they could continue, or use text only. Review available choices without who begins or whether the story continues as leadership, courage or responsibility, or requiring one person to finish everything.

title.zh: 借原创种灯故事比较贡献
title.en: Compare contributions through the original seed-lantern story

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果第一格已经开始折纸种，第二格怎样留给别人一个真正能改变后续的小选择？”各拟一格或一句，再借另一角色角度改一处。可只想象，不必画画、参加共作或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If the first panel began folding a paper seed, which real choice in the second would let another character change what follows?” Draft a panel or sentence each and revise through another role’s angle. Imagine without drawing, joining a creative session or sharing personal experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 可分享不含答案与计数的公开说明。六组是本版原创叙事入口，不是通用动漫分类、荣格原型或心理测量类型；文学角色背景不验证本题本。对方可换角色、不同意、不回答或结束，不用故事推断真人心理、责任或关系质量，也不评价缺席者。
paragraphs.en: Share the public guide without answers or counts. These six original narrative entries are not a universal anime taxonomy, Jungian archetypes or psychometric types; literary role background does not validate the bank. Others may change roles, disagree, decline or stop. Infer no real psychology, duty or relationship quality through the story, and label no absent person.

title.zh: 复盘：比较两种设计，也能不选赢家
title.en: Review two designs without requiring a winner

paragraphs.zh: 沿用两种种灯纸形，选一个双方想比较的效果，例如远景中轮廓是否好认，分别放进同一幅虚构画面。可保留两版、改比较点或不比。复盘说清各版为故事添什么，不给作者排名；比较不同作品也不证明竞争人格、攻击性或谁更值得关注。
paragraphs.en: For two lantern shapes, agree one effect to compare, such as their outlines in a distant view, and place each in the same invented scene. Keep both, change the question or decline comparison. Review what each adds without ranking makers or inferring competitiveness, aggression or entitlement to attention from different work.

title.zh: 借原创种灯故事比较贡献
title.en: Compare contributions through the original seed-lantern story

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果两种纸灯各有适合的场景，怎样比较它们添了什么，而不把创作者分成赢家和输家？”各拟一格或一句，再借另一角色角度改一处。可只想象，不必画画、参加共作或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If two lantern shapes suited different scenes, how would you compare their contributions without making their creators winners and losers?” Draft a panel or sentence each and revise through another role’s angle. Imagine without drawing, joining a creative session or sharing personal experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：地图能回答下一步，而非解释全部
title.en: Review a map for the next move rather than everything

paragraphs.zh: 沿用三地点、两连接的草图，标起点、会合点和一条可能返回路，请愿意的读者复述角色下一步可去哪。若不清楚，只改一处标签或连线；未用角落可空着。可只口头描述。复盘看读者是否跟得上这场故事，不评智力、预测能力或现实中替人规划的资格。
paragraphs.en: For the three-place, two-connection sketch, mark the start, meeting point and a possible return, then ask a willing reader where a character could go next. Change one label or line if unclear, leaving unused corners open. Describe it verbally if preferred. Review this scene’s readability without grading intelligence, foresight or authority to plan another person’s life.

title.zh: 借原创种灯故事比较贡献
title.en: Compare contributions through the original seed-lantern story

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果读者不清楚人物怎样从新台地返回会合点，你会先改哪一条线或哪个标签，而不是补整套世界观？”各拟一格或一句，再借另一角色角度改一处。可只想象，不必画画、参加共作或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a reader could not follow the return from a new terrace, which line or label would you change before adding a whole world system?” Draft a panel or sentence each and revise through another role’s angle. Imagine without drawing, joining a creative session or sharing personal experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：示例有没有增加选择，也能到此结束
title.en: Review an example that expands choice and can finish

paragraphs.zh: 沿用新人请求的一次纸折示范，先确认想看哪一步，再让角色选照做、改形、再问或不试。后续帮助需另问，不默认持续教学。可以只画对话格。复盘看说明是否回应请求、是否给了选择，不以别人是否照做证明智慧、教学能力或照顾义务。
paragraphs.en: For the requested fold demonstration, clarify the step, then let the character copy, alter, ask again or decline. Ask before more help rather than assuming continued teaching. Draw dialogue only if preferred. Review responsiveness and available choices without compliance as proof of wisdom, teaching competence or a caregiving duty.

title.zh: 借原创种灯故事比较贡献
title.en: Compare contributions through the original seed-lantern story

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果新人看完示例想另试一种形状，你会怎样留出探索空间，并让进一步帮助保持可选？”各拟一格或一句，再借另一角色角度改一处。可只想象，不必画画、参加共作或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a newcomer wanted another shape after the example, how would you leave room to explore and keep further help optional?” Draft a panel or sentence each and revise through another role’s angle. Imagine without drawing, joining a creative session or sharing personal experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：道具新用途，试过也能改回
title.en: Review a prop’s new use with room to undo it

paragraphs.zh: 沿用备用折形当路标，画原用途和新用途两版，检查新版本是否让一处场景更好懂或更有趣。愿意的共作者可选原版、新版或都不用；也可只描述点子。复盘把有用变化留在物件和剧情，不拿别人当惊喜对象，不以采用与否评天才、幽默或情绪回避。
paragraphs.en: For a spare folded shape as a marker, show its original and new uses and check whether one scene becomes clearer or more enjoyable. Willing co-creators may keep either or neither; describe the idea only if preferred. Review objects and plot without making someone the target of a surprise or treating acceptance as genius, humour or emotional avoidance.

title.zh: 借原创种灯故事比较贡献
title.en: Compare contributions through the original seed-lantern story

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果备用纸形想改成路标，怎样试一处可撤回的用途，并让其他创作者能保留原版？”各拟一格或一句，再借另一角色角度改一处。可只想象，不必画画、参加共作或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a spare paper shape became a marker, how would you test one reversible use while letting others keep the original?” Draft a panel or sentence each and revise through another role’s angle. Imagine without drawing, joining a creative session or sharing personal experiences.

title.zh: 复盘：具体约定，也有修改和退出办法
title.en: Review a specific agreement with revision and exit

paragraphs.zh: 沿用人物分探台地后的会合，写清地点、适用这一场的范围，以及改路线或不参加时怎样更新。逐项核对，不把一次约定延长成永久责任；也可只写虚构便条。复盘看约定是否可懂、可更新，不以履行多少评忠诚、韧性或人格价值，更不要求谁承担所有风险和照顾。
paragraphs.en: For meeting after separate terrace visits, state the place, the agreement’s scope for this scene and how a changed route or non-participation updates it. Check each without extending one promise into permanent responsibility; write an invented note only. Review clarity and revision without performance as loyalty, resilience or worth, or assigning all risk and care to one character.

title.zh: 借原创种灯故事比较贡献
title.en: Compare contributions through the original seed-lantern story

paragraphs.zh: 可以问：“如果有人想换路线或略过下一场，怎样更新会合约定，而不把改变说成不忠或辜负大家？”各拟一格或一句，再借另一角色角度改一处。可只想象，不必画画、参加共作或公开经历。
paragraphs.en: Ask: “If a character changed route or skipped the next scene, how would you update the meeting agreement without calling the change disloyalty?” Draft a panel or sentence each and revise through another role’s angle. Imagine without drawing, joining a creative session or sharing personal experiences.
